decisions.reason: After two years on the market, this camera is even more tied to the firm's core offer and public commitment, so management is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course.
The sensor suite builds on established capabilities and supports the firm's stated future direction, making any weaker-than-hoped uptake easy to frame as temporary in a long-cycle space market.
Although still new, the radiation-hard camera line is close to the firm's proven business, publicly presented in several models, and therefore likely to receive continued support.

This product has a narrower and less visibly committed market position than the others, but as a very recent launch connected to advanced navigation and imaging, management would still be inclined to give it more time.
